name: Anime Card Battles
desc:
🎪Welcome to Anime Card Battles!

How to play:
🎁Buy a box of cards and open it on the table!
💵Cards have been added to your collection and generate money!
⚔️Use cards to fight with other player!
🏰Fight to the top floor of the Battle Tower!
✨Buy better card box to get the strongest cards!
👍Like the game and join the group!
